title: U.S. Psychedelic Use and Microdosing in 2025 - RAND
abstract: Figure 2 shows weighted estimates of the proportion of U.S. adults who have microdosed each substance at least one day in the past year, according to the 2025 RAND Psychedelics Survey data. These sample sizes reflect the unweighted number of respondents reporting use of each substance in the past year, while percentages reflect survey-weighted estimates to reflect the U.S. adult population who microdosed each substance at least one day in the past year. These sample sizes reflect the unweighted number of respondents reporting use for each substance in the past year, and percentages reflect survey-weighted estimates to reflect the share of microdosing days among the U.S. adult population. NOTES: Sample totals (*n*) for each substance are the unweighted number of respondents reporting use of each substance in the past year, and percentages reflect survey-weighted estimates to reflect the share of microdosing days for each substance in the U.S. adult population.
